title: [MWB][UITests] One type per file; stop suppressing warnings-as-errors (stack 4/4)

proposed_comments.title: Include the startup phase in initialization errors

confidence.rationale: The message omission is directly visible in the exact upstream exception path and the same method records and reports startupStage on timeout; severity remains low because the inner exception still preserves the root cause.

proposed_comments.body:
**Severity: Low — missing startup-phase context makes receiver initialization failures slower to diagnose.**

The worker records `startupStage` before each setup operation and includes it on timeout, but this exception wrapper omits it. The original cause is retained as an inner exception, so this is a diagnostic improvement, not lost root-cause information or a new functional failure.

**If left unchanged:** maintainers must infer which initialization phase failed from the nested exception instead of seeing the recorded phase immediately.

```suggestion
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Receiver initialization failed during " + startupStage + ".", error);
```

The literal current-source replacement compiled using the actual nine-source Windows PowerShell worker compiler. The prior 59 focused endpoint-diagnostics contracts passed; the current UIA invocation change is separate from this unchanged C# initialization path. No interactive VM or failing-initialization runtime experiment was performed.
